يشتجر (form VIII)
# يَشْتَجِرُ (yaštajiru) /jaʃ.ta.d͡ʒi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَجَرَ (ištajara)
# يُشْتَجَرُ (yuštajaru) /juʃ.ta.d͡ʒa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَجَرَ (ištajara)
# يَشْتَجِرَ (yaštajira) /jaʃ.ta.d͡ʒi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَجَرَ (ištajara)
